contentEn:
For most Metro Vancouver homeowners, a bathroom renovation delivers better upfront return on investment, while a kitchen renovation yields more at resale. Reno Stars has cost data from real contracts signed in Richmond, Burnaby, Surrey, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, and Vancouver proper between 2023 and 2025.

Kitchen Renovation Costs and ROI in Vancouver

A kitchen refresh in Vancouver starts around $25,000 for cosmetic work — new countertop, cabinet hardware, and paint with no layout change. A mid-range full renovation at $40,000-$80,000 replaces cabinet boxes, adds quartz countertops, and retiles the backsplash. Premium projects with custom cabinetry and layout changes run $80,000-$150,000. Reno Stars completed a custom black-fixture kitchen in Burnaby and a budget-friendly kitchen in Coquitlam in 2024-2025, giving us real Vancouver pricing across all tiers. Resale uplift for a mid-range kitchen in Vancouver typically recovers 70-80 percent of project cost.

Bathroom Renovation Costs and ROI in Vancouver

A minor bathroom refresh in Vancouver starts from $12,000, covering new vanity, toilet, fixtures, and tile resurfacing. A standard five-fixture mid-range renovation runs $18,000-$38,000 fully installed. Premium projects with heated floors, frameless glass, and natural stone can reach $40,000-$55,000. Reno Stars' two-bathroom renovation in Burnaby and daughter's bath renovation in Richmond illustrate real Metro Vancouver project costs. A mid-range bathroom renovation typically recovers 60-70 percent of cost at resale.

Direct Cost Comparison: Kitchen vs Bathroom

Reno Stars' 2023-2025 project data for Vancouver and surrounding cities:

ScopeKitchenBathroom
Minor refresh$25K-$40K$12K-$20K
Mid-range full$40K-$80K$18K-$38K
Premium/layout change$80K-$150K$40K-$55K
Typical resale recovery70-80%60-70%

Bathroom renovation costs roughly half of a comparable kitchen. Per dollar spent, it delivers strong everyday comfort for homeowners staying five to seven years.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Which Should You Do First?

For Vancouver homeowners planning to stay seven years or more, a full kitchen renovation usually makes the stronger long-term financial case. For those on a tighter budget or selling within five years, a mid-range bathroom renovation offers the best balance of cost, disruption, and resale impact. Reno Stars generally recommends completing the bathroom first when updating both over time — lower cost, shorter timeline, immediate quality-of-life improvement.

2026 Vancouver Renovation Budget Planning

Reno Stars advises Vancouver homeowners to budget in three layers: the known project cost, a 10 percent contingency (essential for pre-1940s character homes), and a 5 percent allowance for permits and inspections. For a $60,000 kitchen project in Vancouver, the realistic total budget is approximately $69,000. Reno Stars provides itemized invoices and works within agreed fixed-price contracts for every project.

How long does a kitchen renovation take in Vancouver?

A minor kitchen refresh takes 2-4 weeks. A mid-range full renovation runs 6-10 weeks. A premium kitchen with layout changes typically requires 10-16 weeks. All timelines include permit handling and final walkthrough.

How long does a bathroom renovation take in Vancouver?

A minor bathroom refresh takes 1-2 weeks. A mid-range full renovation runs 3-5 weeks. A premium bathroom with heated floors and custom tile typically takes 5-8 weeks.

Does a kitchen or bathroom renovation add more value to a Vancouver home?

A kitchen renovation adds more absolute dollar value at resale in Vancouver, recovering 70-80 percent of project cost versus 60-70 percent for a bathroom. Per dollar invested, a mid-range bathroom often provides better short-term comfort and resale impact for homeowners staying less than seven years.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom or kitchen renovation in Vancouver?

Bathroom renovations typically do not require permits unless involving plumbing reconfiguration, electrical panel upgrades, or structural changes. Kitchen renovations with layout changes, gas line moves, or electrical upgrades require permits. Reno Stars handles all permit applications on behalf of homeowners.

对于大多数大温哥华地区业主来说，浴室装修通常带来更好的即时投资回报，而厨房装修在转售时增值更多。聚星装修拥有2023至2025年在列治文、本拿比、素里、高贵林、北温、西温及温哥华签定的真实合同造价数据。

温哥华厨房装修费用与投资回报

温哥华厨房小型翻新起价约25,000加元，包括新台面、橱柜五金和油漆，不改变布局。中档全包装修40,000至80,000加元，更换柜体并添加石英石台面。高端项目含订制橱柜和布局改动，造价80,000至150,000加元。聚星装修在2024至2025年完成了本拿比黑色五金订制厨房和高贵林经济型厨房的真实项目，掌握各档次的温哥华实际造价数据。中档厨房装修在转售时通常可收回成本的70%至80%。

温哥华浴室装修费用与投资回报

温哥华浴室小型翻新起价约12,000加元。标准五件套中档装修全包装修费用为18,000至38,000加元。配备地暖、无框玻璃和天然石材瓷砖的高端装修可达40,000至55,000加元。聚星装修在列治文和本拿比的真实项目数据表明，中档浴室装修在转售时通常可收回成本的60%至70%。

厨房与浴室装修费用直接对比

聚星装修2023至2025年的项目数据显示温哥华及周边城市装修费用如下：

工程范围厨房浴室
小型翻新25,000-40,000加元12,000-20,000加元
中档全包装修40,000-80,000加元18,000-38,000加元
高端/布局改动80,000-150,000加元40,000-55,000加元
典型转售回收率70-80%60-70%

浴室装修费用通常约为同等厨房项目的一半。按每元投入计算，浴室对居住五至七年的业主往往带来更好的日常舒适度。

正在规划厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？立即联系聚星装修，获取免费、无义务报价。

应该先装修哪个？

对于计划居住七年或以上的温哥华业主，全包装修通常在长期财务上更合算。对于预算较紧或计划五年内售房的业主，中档浴室装修在成本、施工扰攘和转售影响之间取得最佳平衡。两处都要分阶段装修时，聚星装修通常建议先完成浴室——费用更低、工期更短、即时的生活质量提升更明显。

2026年温哥华装修预算规划

聚星装修建议温哥华业主分三层编制预算：已知项目费用、10%应急储备（1940年代前特色住宅尤为重要）以及5%的许可证和检查费用附加。以温哥华一项60,000加元的厨房装修为例，合理的总预算约为69,000加元。聚星装修为每个项目提供逐项发票，并在固定价格合同范围内施工。

温哥华厨房装修需要多长时间？

小型厨房翻新需2-4周。中档全包装修需6-10周。含布局改动的高端厨房通常需10-16周。所有工期均含许可证办理和最终验收。

温哥华浴室装修需要多长时间？

小型浴室翻新需1-2周。中档全包装修需3-5周。含地暖的高端浴室通常需5-8周。

厨房或浴室装修哪个为温哥华住宅增值更多？

在当前市场，厨房装修在转售时增值更多绝对金额，中档装修可收回成本的70-80%，而浴室为60-70%。然而按每元投入计算，对于居住少于七年的业主，中档浴室装修往往提供更好的短期舒适度和转售影响。

温哥华厨房或浴室装修需要申请许可证吗？

除非涉及管道改造、电气面板升级或结构改动，否则浴室装修通常不需要许可证。涉及布局改动、燃气管道移动或电气升级的厨房装修需要许可证。聚星装修代业主处理所有许可证申请。
